verdict.rationale: Asana documents a first-party developer sandbox, a temporary Asana domain with limited users, which gives a test environment separate from a production workspace. The deprecation-header testing and read-only MCP tools are adjacent features, not sandbox isolation, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that sandbox data is isolated from production, details on provisioning, lifespan and API/MCP use within the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: A developer sandbox is a temporary Asana domain with limited users.
